# `fec_outside_spending_spenders`

**Reported independent expenditure filers**

Reported independent expenditure filers with exact source coordinates and explicit interpretation limits.

**Coverage.** Window. Selected publisher candidate/cycle groups; Form 5 identities and unresolved filers remain separate. *(measured 2026-11-13)*

- **Parquet file:** `fec_outside_spending_spenders.parquet`
- **MCP `query_sql` support:** Configured; requires an available artifact.
- **Publication status:** Not established by this schema page or its measurement date.
- **Row count:** Not stated here; the MCP `describe_table` reply gives the live count under `publication`.

| Column | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `profile_id` | `VARCHAR` | Identity of one selected profile; not an economic transaction ID. |
| `candidate_id` | `VARCHAR` | Native candidate ID. Different offices may have different IDs for the same person. |
| `candidate_name` | `VARCHAR` | Literal source candidate label, independent of identifier resolution. |
| `support_oppose` | `VARCHAR` | Source S (support) or O (oppose); unresolved indicators refuse aggregation. |
| `source_evidence_json` | `VARCHAR` | Exact retained request descriptors, original digests, sizes and capture dates. |
| `source_generation` | `VARCHAR` | Digest binding the selected original query captures and interpretation policy. |
| `period_start` | `VARCHAR` | Declared report or cycle coverage start, not necessarily the earliest transaction date. |
| `period_end` | `VARCHAR` | Declared report or cycle coverage end, not necessarily the latest transaction date. |
| `election_basis` | `VARCHAR` | All elections in the selected two-year cycle; election-specific queries refuse. |
| `amount_basis` | `VARCHAR` | Declared publisher or selected-report measure basis. Alternative representations are not added. |
| `policy_version` | `VARCHAR` | Version of the named interpretation and selection rules. |
| `coverage_note` | `VARCHAR` | Explicit population, timing, attribution and financial limits of this named output. |
| `record_id` | `VARCHAR` | Deterministic identity of one native observation, bound to its source digest and coordinates. |
| `spender_id` | `VARCHAR` | Native filer ID; C9 IDs remain Form 5 filer identities rather than inferred committees. |
| `spender_name` | `VARCHAR` | Literal reporting filer label, not an independently resolved organization. |
| `spender_namespace` | `VARCHAR` | FEC committee, FEC Form 5 filer, or unresolved source identity. |
| `total` | `VARCHAR` | Exact USD decimal text for the named publisher group or total. |
| `source_cycle` | `INTEGER` | Selected two-year FEC cycle or completed result edition. |
| `reported_transaction_count` | `BIGINT` | Publisher number of transactions behind one group; never a spender count. |
